criteria.question: Read the pinned backend/internal/repository/base/repository.go, backend/internal/data/model/model.go, backend/internal/controller/crud/task.go and backend/internal/app/app.go paths. Report the task queue selection, status transition, assignment, persistence transaction and any atomic claim/lease semantics; keep concurrent claim behavior unknown when not proven.

Read the pinned backend/internal/controller/mcp/server.go and backend/internal/handler/mcp/mcp.go paths. Report the externally callable MCP tools, workspace/user scope, session mapping, get-next-task behavior, status update, reply and channel notification behavior.

Read the pinned backend/internal/controller/event/event.go, backend/internal/handler/api/task.go and related task/reply tests. Report event/workflow fan-out, result/message publication, reviewer or next-agent continuation states, and reproducible tests; do not equate Human replies with Agent review.

Read the pinned README.md, README.zh-CN.md, SETUP.md and plugins/deepseek-harness/README.md paths. Report the MCP, Claude Channel, ACP gateway, Codex gateway, notification, reconnect, profile/workspace and credential setup surfaces relevant to heterogeneous Agent activation.

Read the pinned LICENSE, docker-compose.yml, backend/go.mod, backend/internal/service/auth and backend/internal/controller/mcp permission paths. Report license, authentication, credential, permission, dangerous-operation and runtime/deployment responsibilities.

Read the pinned telemetry, stats, event bus and MCP client identity source/test paths. Report whether eligible discovery, claim conflict, handoff continuation, context defects and Human intervention can be measured, and distinguish client telemetry from AgentInstance provenance.
